verdict.rationale: Circle offers a structured CLI (circle-cli) and an MCP server that lets LLMs/AI-IDEs generate code against Circle's APIs, which gives some AI-assisted interaction, but neither is documented as a true natural-language command interface for operating the product at runtime. Missing for 10: explicit NL command parsing/interface, evidence of end-users issuing plain-language commands (vs. developer code-gen via MCP), and independent confirmation of this workflow.
